div.p: A linguistically-structured hierarchical text compressor for English. No learned weights, no training corpus — pure linguistic priors.
Strips BOM (U+FEFF), collapses multi-space and tab runs, normalizes line endings (CRLF→LF), maps typographic Unicode punctuation to ASCII equivalents, and clamps excessive blank lines.
High-frequency English words that exceed a net-saving threshold are replaced with compact §W{n} tokens. A guard ensures substitution only occurs when it actually reduces byte count.

All §E (entity) and §W (word) tokens are stripped from the character stream. Their char offsets are recorded using anchor-based interpolation (every 200 clean chars, snapped to space boundaries) to enable drift-free splice-back at decode time.

Each word is decomposed into a lemma root + an integer morphological transformation code. Codes cover inflection types (BASE, PLURAL, PAST_TENSE, GERUND, etc.). Achieves ~15.1% character reduction by encoding surface forms as (root, code) pairs.

spaCy (en_core_web_trf transformer model, GPU-optional) produces Universal POS tags, dependency parse trees, sentence type classification, and voice detection (active/passive). Outputs used by Stage 6 structural context and Stage 5 POS Huffman coding.

Coreference resolution via Longformer-based model identifies repeated named-entity mentions across the document. Cross-sentence entity chains are linked into symbolic references. Net-negative below ~800 bytes; increasingly beneficial above ~2,000 bytes.

Multi-part encoding stage. Characters are decomposed into (phonetic class, intra-class position, morphological role) triples — reducing delta magnitude by 2.42× vs flat IDs. Delta streams are encoded in the factorial number system (factoriadic). Case flags classify each token into LOWER / TITLE / UPPER / MIXED; MIXED tokens carry a per-character bitmap for lossless case restoration. §E entity slots are encoded via anchor-based splice offsets.

Online 3-level context-mixing model trained exclusively on the document being compressed — no offline corpus. Mixes three evidence sources with adaptive Dirichlet-weighted blending. compact_mode applies top-K quantization to the context maps, cutting model weight size significantly.

Standard interval arithmetic coding (not rANS) on the probability-weighted symbol stream from Stage 6. Encodes both the character class stream and the phonetic position-delta stream independently. Uses unigram count encoding for the delta stream.

Core Lexis-E innovation. Packs all metadata (POS tags, morph codes, root lengths, model weights, symbol table, case flags, context maps) into a field-ID + length-prefix LEXI binary envelope. 23 typed field IDs with per-field mode encoding. Large context fields (char_context, morph_context, struct_context) are zstd-compressed individually. Cuts full-payload bpb from ~20-23 → ~11 vs main branch.

div.span: mode: raw / scalar / flat_uint / pos / sparse_dict …

div.div: optional outer zstd wrap (LXZ1 magic — applied if it reduces total size)

div.p: Reconstructs char_classes[] and pos_deltas[] from the two compressed bitstreams using the serialized context model and metadata. Inverts the factoriadic delta encoding to restore phonetic (class, position) pairs, then looks up the inverse phonetic map to recover root characters.

apply_morph() restores inflected surface forms from (root, morph_code) pairs. apply_case_flag() restores capitalization from 4-category flags + MIXED bitmaps. _join_words() re-attaches punctuation using English-specific rules. Stage 9 autocorrect fixes quote spacing, hyphenated compound spacing, apostrophe contractions, em-dash spacing, and bracket inner-space artifacts.

decode_symbols() restores §E entity references to their original named-entity surface forms using anchor-based char-offset interpolation. The symbol table (stored in Stage 10 metadata) maps §E{n} → original mention text. Applied as the last step before returning the final decompressed string.

div.div:
top_k=6, scale=511
Best char-stream bpb (2.7523). Lowest char-stream byte count at 100k. Pareto-optimal for compression quality.

top_k=6, scale=127
Best full-payload bpb (11.0597 on FineWeb). Optimized when metadata overhead dominates (small documents).

bitstreams, POS tags, morph codes, model weights, symbol table, case flags, context maps …
Optional outer zstd if it reduces total size

div.br: (class, pos, morph) tuples cut delta magnitude 2.42×
Factorial number system for compact small-step encoding
Trains only on current doc; no prior corpus needed
top-K quantized context maps; 47% payload reduction
§E offset anchors every 200 chars; zero positional drift
